name: Alcalá de los Gazules (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided crimson over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alcalá de los Gazules (a castle and lions, a tower and a horseman).
history: Municipal flag of Alcalá de los Gazules; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alcalá de los Gazules arms — castle and lions, tower and horseman
